name: Daniel Cowpe
bio: Daniel is a final-year MChem student at the University of St Andrews. During the past two summers, he has undertaken research internships: first at St Andrews with Prof. Douglas Philp (2025), studying chemical replicator dynamics in a continuous stirred-tank reactor; and then at the University of Hamburg with Prof. Jakob Albert (2026), carrying out the synthesis and protonation of polyoxometalates.
education: University of St Andrews (MChem in Chemistry, 2022–27)
awards: Carnegie Vacation Scholarship, University of St Andrews (2025)
DAAD RISE Scholarship, University of Hamburg (2026)
